details.publicNotes:
Amber brambles are round thorny plants oozing sap. They're carnivorous, and they prefer to ambush their prey. Though their serrated leaves and the spines covering their branches pose an obvious danger, their poisonous sap is also deadly. When set loose from the brambles' branches, the sap hardens rapidly, encasing tiny animals entirely in an amberlike substance and restricting the breathing of larger prey. While many predators are content to hunt only when they are hungry, amber brambles prefer to hunt far more than they need, encasing the extra meat in sap for later consumption.

It is not uncommon to find these plants in the domain of other fey, who see them as either wonderful additions to a garden (in the case of more powerful fey) or as dangerous additions to home defense (in the case of weaker fey, especially gremlins). Taming an amber bramble often requires an offering of a staggering amount of fresh meat.

Some people harvest amber bramble sap and refine it into a psychoactive drug. Others collect and sell amber stones with interesting prey trapped inside. However, many prospective amber collectors discover that the plants are hostile to those who steal their captured prey, never forgiving the transgression against their rightfully earned meals.

Frozen In Time

The body of a creature suffocated by an amber bramble's sap is preserved in a pristine state, often frozen in mid-action. Evil fey creatures sometimes display amber bramble victims in sinister dioramas that depict dances, legendary battles, or other active scenes. Some of these fey believe that by preserving these statues, they are doing a service: the victims' perfect preservation means that they can be restored to life long after the usual magical deadline to do so has passed. Others simply use them as exotic paperweights.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 7/18/30 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing), armor (light, medium), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Nature, Stealth, Survival)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, constitution, dexterity, energy resistant (vitality), poison, poisonous armor, sensory (low- light vision), strength, tangle shield, throwing, wild, wisdom, wood
